{{Top|leg}}
'''Bastelt''' was a chemical element. When combined with [[heldrium]], it created a clear, odorless liquid tracer compound used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bio-hound|bio-hounds]] to track their targets.<ref name="Cracken">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>
